messages:
maria: Heads-up 1 please review the SI onboarding playbook I uploaded and flag any missing items before we share with partners.
lee: Quick skim looks good. Need a clear dependency table for marketplace listings and any hardware validation we require.
jamal: SE requirements: provide a pre-provisioned dev tenant, a sample webhook->Redwood integration repo, and an automated smoke test so SIs can demo reliably.
sophia: Proposal for cert tiers: Integrator, Certified Integrator, Partner Engineer. Each tier = hands-on lab + deployment review. Add co-branded badge + verified listing in marketplace.
anita: I'll build 3 short labs (quickstart, inference+ops, embedding pipelines) in the LMS. Prefer self-serve labs with a proctored capstone for the higher tiers. Example smoke test:

```
# smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-1-small","input":"ping"}' | jq -r '.output[0]'
# expect: contains("ping")
```

lee: For hardware partners (NVIDIA/Lambda/CoreWeave) we need a validation checklist: driver versions, CUDA, nv_peer_mem, NIC MTU, and a bootable lab image. Also request partner lab credits for instructor-led workshops.
partner-bot: FYI: we have a partner lab image v1.2 in the bucket: s3://redwood-partner-labs/v1.2.
maria: Access and security: who owns dev tenant provisioning and service account playbook? Need KMS/HSM sign-off for private deployments.
jamal: Ops should own provisioning (small team). I can draft a playbook: service account templates, least-privilege scopes, and KMS access steps.
sophia: Grading rubric idea: 50% lab completion, 30% deployment review (must run 72h in staging), 20% timed exam. Keep exam scenario-based, 30m.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace staging accepts custom metadata. We can add cert_level, cert_date, cert_id fields to listings.
lee: We'll need marketplace eng to add a verify_cert URL and searchable tag for "Certified SI". Also internal escalation path if an SI hits hardware issues: jamal -> infra-support -> partner-eng.
maria: Timeline suggestion: share draft with SI leads by Wed (first_message_ts + 4d), kickoff workshop in 2.5 weeks, pilot cohort starts week 5.
anita: Request a minimal model pack (configs + quant profiles) and two deterministic prompt templates so labs are repeatable.
jamal: Agree. I'll assemble a model pack and provide a repo with CI smoke tests and badge issuance API hooks.
sophia: Marketing: prefer a soft launch (blog + webinar) after 3 SIs are certified. Prepare co-brand kit and an announcement calendar.
maria: Action items: anita -> labs/LMS; jamal -> dev tenant + model pack; lee -> hardware checklist + partner credits; sophia -> cert rubric + marketing kit; maria -> program owner & announce plan. If you agree, react :thumbsup: or respond with blockers.
